I can't answer that from this evidence. The tool checked 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, which is the month *after* 2026-10-04. The two weeks *before* that date (about 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04) fall outside the evaluated period, and the evidence explicitly says it establishes nothing outside that period.

For the period it did cover, NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting the property (count 0). All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day. Even that result doesn't prove no fire occurred, since small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. It also says nothing about burned area or cause.

To answer your question, the check would need to be rerun for roughly 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04.
